reason: A DeepSeek Harness extension suite primarily focused on plugin installation and runtime loading, subagent orchestration, model routing, skill management, and cross-session collaboration; human review is warranted because it executes installed plugins with host-process permissions and supports broad runtime and session capabilities.

summaries.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的插件编排套件，提供插件安装与运行时加载、子代理团队协作、模型路由、技能管理及跨会话通信功能。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness orchestration suite for plugin installation and runtime loading, subagent teamwork, model routing, skill management, and cross-session communication.

capabilities: Installs, loads, reloads, stops, and removes plugins, including dynamically sourced plugins
Executes installed plugins with host-process permissions and no sandbox isolation
Routes tasks across models and providers and can spawn subagents with selected models and modes
Creates agent teams, assigns tasks, coordinates dependencies, and sends messages between sessions
Reads and sends messages across sessions and persists offline mailbox data
Manages persistent skills and injects runtime context or tools into sessions
Provides optional GitHub MCP integration using a user-supplied token
